open_points.subject: capture input provenance
open_points.text: “It copies its inputs, spooled files included, into the case” / “The functions capability keeps the broad PortRef input contract.”
open_points.question: Must the supplied PortRef tuple be derived from, or checked for exact equality with, the captured NodeExecution’s recorded inputs, and which layer performs that check?
options: The caller constructs the tuple exclusively from the NodeExecution
The capability verifies exact equality with the NodeExecution inputs
Any fitting supplied tuple may become the captured case
open_points.default_guess: Require the capability to verify exact equality with the NodeExecution’s recorded inputs.

open_points.subject: capture refusal precedence for malformed tuples
open_points.text: “Next it checks the complete input tuple for facts-only file references, before looking up any input value or spooled file.” / “ports taken in name order and, for one port, presence, carriage, schema, then size.”
open_points.question: When a tuple both contains a FileFactsRef and has a structural fault such as a missing, extra, duplicated, or wrongly carried port, does the structural fault or the FileFactsRef refusal win?
options: Scan for FileFactsRef before every tuple-shape and port-fit check
Check tuple shape first, then scan for FileFactsRef before reference lookup
Apply the existing per-port presence/carriage order, allowing an earlier port fault to win
open_points.default_guess: Check tuple shape first, then refuse the smallest FileFactsRef port before resolving any referenced value or file.

open_points.subject: capture precedence between boundary reference checks and FileFactsRef
open_points.text: “The following order is local to that callable, after the external request checks of A16” / “A request naming a record that does not exist … is refused as State 0's unknown reference before that record's own checks” / “Any FileFactsRef … is refused … before looking up any input value or spooled file.”
open_points.question: If the same capture request contains a FileFactsRef and an unknown StoredValuesRef or SpooledFilesRef, must A16 resolve the unknown directly named reference first, or must the FileFactsRef refusal occur with no input lookup?
options: A16 wins: return unknown_reference after looking up the unknown input reference
The FileFactsRef scan wins: refuse FileFactsRef without resolving any input reference
A16 does not treat PortRefs nested in the capture tuple as directly named records
open_points.default_guess: Treat the PortRefs as operation inputs and let the explicit FileFactsRef scan run before resolving any of them.
